dialogues.speaker: Chaplina
dialogues.text: Well enough. At least it's kept running this long... Now even more people can come gather around it to keep warm.

dialogues.speaker: Chaplina
dialogues.text: Supposedly, once the temperature stabilizes, its energy consumption will slowly drop. At least, that's what I overheard... uh, well, what those loud guys from the Snezhnayan Energy Commission were saying, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Chaplina
dialogues.text: If we can just get our hands on some Kresnik Kristall ore, maybe we can keep this thing running for a really long time...
